name: Construction & Civil Engineering
shortSummary: Roads, buildings, earthworks, drainage and erosion control.
summary: Design and construction of roads, buildings and civil works, from earthworks to finished surfaces.
body: Civil engineering is where Sato began. We design and build the infrastructure that institutions and communities depend on, and we manage every stage, from site preparation to handover.
Our own plant and workshop mean we mobilise without waiting on hired equipment, and keep control of quality and programme on site.
capabilities: Civil engineering design
Asphaltic concrete road construction and road rehabilitation
Pavement design, construction and repair, including heavy-duty terminal pavements
Earthworks: grading, laterite filling, sub-base compaction
Drainage systems, kerbs, culverts and walkways
Building construction: academic, administrative, laboratory, residential and office buildings
Renovation and conversion of existing buildings
Erosion control

name: Electrical Engineering
shortSummary: Power, instrumentation, metering and electrical installations.
summary: Electrical installation, instrumentation and metering for buildings, water schemes and industrial sites.
body: Sato was founded by an electrical engineer, and electrical work runs through the firm's project record — from the pump control and high lift installations on water supply schemes to the supply and installation of bulk and prepayment metering for utilities and development programmes.
We deliver electrical works as part of a wider contract or as a package in their own right, and we commission what we install.
capabilities: Electrical installation for buildings and industrial sites
Power distribution and switchgear installation
Pump control panels and motor control centres
Instrumentation and control systems
Supply, installation and commissioning of bulk, prepayment and electromagnetic meters
Solar power systems, including solar-powered borehole installations
Standby generation and changeover systems
Testing, commissioning and handover

name: Mechanical Engineering
shortSummary: Pumps, pipework, plant installation and mechanical maintenance.
summary: Mechanical installation and maintenance for water, building services and plant.
body: Sato's mechanical work sits alongside its civil and water engineering: pump houses, high lift pump installation, pipework and the plant that keeps a scheme running. The firm maintains its own fleet and workshop, which is where much of this capability was built.
We take on mechanical packages within our own contracts and as standalone installation and maintenance work.
capabilities: Pump installation, commissioning and overhaul
Pipework fabrication and installation, including ductile iron and UPVC mains
Pumping station and pump house mechanical fit-out
Static and rotating equipment installation
Mechanical building services
Workshop fabrication and welding
Planned and corrective maintenance of plant and equipment

name: Water Resources & Environmental Engineering
shortSummary: Dams, water supply, boreholes, river works, drainage and erosion control.
summary: Dams, water supply, boreholes and river works, with the drainage, flood and erosion control that protects them.
body: Water infrastructure has been central to Sato's work for decades, with clients including the Ogun-Osun River Basin Development Authority, state water corporations, the Federal Ministry of Water Resources and the World Bank.

The environmental side of the same discipline — flood and erosion control, river training, drainage and groundwater — is delivered by the same teams, because on most of these schemes they are one job.
capabilities: Earth dam construction
Irrigation development
Water supply scheme construction and rehabilitation, including intake structures and pump houses
Water treatment facilities
Sewage systems
Borehole drilling, including solar-powered boreholes, with our own drilling rig
Hydrogeology and groundwater development
River dredging and stream channelization
Flood and erosion control

name: Energy Services
shortSummary: Asset integrity, facility engineering and renewable energy.
summary: Engineering support for energy assets, from integrity management to renewable generation.
body: Energy Services brings Sato's engineering and maintenance disciplines to power and process assets: keeping plant fit for purpose across its life, and building the generation and distribution that sites depend on.

The division is delivered with technical partners whose specialist teams complement Sato's site engineering and project management. Sato is building this capability deliberately, and will describe delivered work here as it is completed.
capabilities: Asset integrity management across design, maintenance, inspection and operations
Life-cycle integrity monitoring of static and rotating equipment
Facility and production engineering support
Compliance with relevant regulations and industry codes
Risk assessment and reduction to as low as reasonably practicable
Solar generation and hybrid power systems
Renewable and bio-energy technologies
Energy efficiency assessment

name: Oil & Gas Services
shortSummary: Subsurface studies, field development planning and pipeline engineering.
summary: Subsurface, field development and pipeline engineering support for upstream operators.
body: Sato offers upstream engineering support through its technical partners, covering the subsurface and field development work that sits behind an investment decision, and the pipeline and facilities engineering that follows it.

This division is addressed to operators and their procurement and vendor-verification teams. Sato's own record is in civil, water and electrical infrastructure; the oil and gas capability below is delivered with partners and is described as capability, not as completed Sato projects.
capabilities: Integrated subsurface studies
Geological studies and formation evaluation
Seismic data processing, interpretation and inversion
Reservoir planning and optimisation
Field development planning and conceptualisation
Production and reservoir management
Dynamic pipeline simulation and pipeline integrity monitoring
Integrated asset modelling and optimisation
Hydrocarbon accounting
Civil, structural and electrical works for onshore facilities

name: Digitalization & Digital Twin Services
shortSummary: Asset data, analytics and virtual models of physical infrastructure.
summary: Turning asset data into a working digital model that operators can plan and maintain from.
body: A digital twin is a maintained virtual model of a physical asset, fed by its own operating and inspection data, used to plan maintenance, test changes before they are made and see condition without going to site.

Sato approaches this from the infrastructure side: the firm already supplies and installs the metering and instrumentation that such a model depends on. Delivery is with technical partners, and Sato has no completed digital twin projects to cite yet.
capabilities: Virtual asset management and digital twin models
Asset data capture, structuring and management
Big data platforms and analytics for infrastructure and energy assets
Instrumentation and telemetry to feed asset models
Condition and performance dashboards
Digitalisation of maintenance and inspection records
Integration with metering and utility billing data

name: Research, Technology & Innovation
shortSummary: Applied studies, technical training and new engineering methods.
summary: Applied research, technical training and the evaluation of new methods and technologies.
body: Sato invests in the technical development of its own people and, with partners, in applied studies that test whether a method or technology is worth adopting on Nigerian projects.
This division is new. It is offered as a capability rather than a record of delivered research, and its scope will be described more precisely as work is completed.
capabilities: Applied engineering studies and feasibility work
Evaluation of new materials, methods and technologies
Technical training for client and contractor teams
Petro-technical and facility management training
Cost engineering and estimation
Knowledge transfer and capability building on projects
